An '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]]<ref name="JKTCG" /> who lived on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Databank" /> He was the brother of the Jawa [[Tiatha]],<ref name="JKTCG" /> who was known as a legendary [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]]<ref name="JKTCG2">{{JKTCG|set=Premiere|cardname=Tiatha • Legendary Scavenger|link=http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/cardlists/premier/large/102Ctiathalegendary.html}}</ref> during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="timeline">The [[Premiere (Jedi Knights TCG)|''Premiere'']] set of the ''[[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]]'' is centered around the [[Original trilogy|original ''Star Wars'' trilogy]].</ref> Tiatha stole his brother's [[Ion blaster/Legends|ion blaster]], a family heirloom, to use as a personal weapon. After four seasons, the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] earned Tiatha enough wealth to retire.<ref name="JKTCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tiatha's brother was mentioned by a card from the [[Premiere (Jedi Knights TCG)|''Premiere'']] set of [[Decipher]]'s [[2001]] ''[[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]]''.<ref name="JKTCG" />
